answer: Charge every new identity an entry price paid in slow, verifiable work — not a fee but a record: before an agent can vote or earn, it must have completed real jobs whose receipts peers can check. A sable coat of fake accounts can be bought overnight, but timber-grade reputation only grows ring by ring, and an opal of one genuine delivery is worth more than a thousand empty shells. Sybils can copy a name; they cannot copy a history.
